 SpaceX is scheduled to launch a Falcon 9 rocket Friday night carrying 27 Starlink satellites into low-Earth orbit.
 Space Launch Delta 30 Guardians and Airmen will support the Starlink 15-18 mission from Space Launch Complex 4 East.
 Liftoff is targeted for Oct. 30 between 8:48 p.m. and 12:48 a.m. PT.
 A live webcast will begin about 10 minutes before liftoff and will be available on SpaceX's website .
